modules.name: 3.1 NoSQL, MongoDB & CRUD

The key modelling decision · The four CRUD operations, mongosh style · Query operators: write the filters · Update operators: $inc, $addToSet, $pull and updateMany · The no-schema trap: find and repair inconsistent documents
